text:
oliver: post-deploy quickcheck - prefill/backfill synthetic in eu-west2 showing spike in 5xx and p95. baseline ~0.2% 5xx -> observed ~4% over last 6m after backfill job kicked. rollout at 40%. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy report: release-2026-04-01-backfill started 2026-04-01T10:00Z. Targets: api-prod. Rollout progress: 40%. Canary checks: PASS. Postdeploy synth: ALERT. Link: https://deploy/release-2026-04-01-backfill

maya: looking at job traces - backfill worker queue length jumped and kv-warmup sidecars are getting overwhelmed, causing cascade of kv-cache misses and upstream 502/504s. snippet:
```
[2026-04-01T10:12:11Z] backfill-worker pid=789 INFO queued=124 processed=8
[2026-04-01T10:12:12Z] kv-warmup pid=456 WARN backlog=320 warmups/sec=1
[2026-04-01T10:12:12Z] proxy pid=321 INFO upstream=502 route=/v1/prefill-backfill host=eu-west2-b
```

sandeep: mitigation options: pause the backfill job, throttle backfill concurrency, temporarily increase warmup workers, or regionally pin /v1/prefill-backfill to an older variant. prefer pause + targeted smoke to avoid a rollback.

oliver: holding rollout at 40%. pausing the backfill job and running a targeted smoke now. commands:
```
redwoodctl jobs pause --name prefill-backfill-eu-west2 --by oliver --reason "postdeploy warmup backlog causing 5xx"
redwoodctl smoke run --region eu-west2 --route /v1/prefill-backfill --samples 300 --type postdeploy-synth
```

deploy-bot: Action logged: backfill job paused; rollout hold set at 40% by oliver @ 2026-04-01T10:15Z. Smoke job scheduled.

health-bot: smoke job started: id=smoke-2997924580-1 region=eu-west2 samples=300 type=postdeploy-prefill

maya: restarted kv-warmup sidecars on eu-west2-b to flush backlog and temporarily bumped warmup worker count (+2) via runtime feature flag. no image change.

health-bot: smoke job update: 150/300 sampled -> 5xx rate down from 4% to 0.7%, p95 improved from 310ms -> 140ms. continuing.

sandeep: good signal. plan: keep backfill paused and hold rollout for a 20m observation window. if stable, resume backfill with concurrency cap=5 and exponential backoff in warmup loop. also add canary preflight that asserts warmup throughput >= 50 warmups/min before backfill job starts.

oliver: agreed. adding release notes entry: "release-2026-04-01-backfill: prefill-backfill job paused in eu-west2 due to warmup backlog causing 5xx. Warmup workers bumped and sidecars restarted; targeted smoke passed. Backfill will resume with concurrency cap and warmup preflight. No rollback."

deploy-bot: Hold recorded: rollout paused by oliver. Observability window: 20m. Next auto-action: resume rollout if no alerts; backfill job resume is manual after operator validation.

health-bot: smoke job complete: id=smoke-2997924580-1 results: 300/300 OK, 0/300 5xx, p95=138ms, notes="job paused; warmup workers increased; warmup preflight planned"

maya: filing follow-up ticket with reproducer steps and adding the warmup preflight to canary job checklist. assigning to infra and data-pipeline.

sandeep: I'll draft the backfill resume runbook (concurrency guardrails + sampling plan) and coordinate a staged resume once infra thumbs-up.

oliver: thanks everyone. good catch. :white_check_mark:
